annotations.title: Rename or describe a Pinterest board

description: Renames or re-describes one board on a connected Pinterest account. Ask the user before creating or changing a board, and show them the new name or description first. Give a name, a description or both; what is left out stays. Answers the board as Pinterest now has it. Where it is the account’s chosen board, the account’s name follows the new board name.

accountId.description: A connected Pinterest account id from accounts_list.

boardId.description: The board’s id, from boards_list or boards_create.

brandId.description: The brand this is for, by its id from brands_list. Needed when the login has more than one brand; with one brand it can be left out.

description.description: A new description, up to 500 characters. Left out, it stays as it is.

name.description: A new name, up to 80 characters. Left out, the name stays as it is.

name: boards_edit
title: Rename or describe a Pinterest board
